versions.name: Bay Springs Scout Base
versions.summary: A primitive Natchez Trace Council tent-camping base on a peninsula surrounded by Bay Springs Lake east of Booneville in northeast Mississippi, with no permanent facilities.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Natchez Trace Council facilities page, which lists Bay Springs Scout Base as a current council property (the source's 'Andrew Jackson Council' label is wrong — the Pushmataha and Yocona councils that formerly served these counties merged into Natchez Trace Council). Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate (the lake address does not street-geocode); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's own facilities page; classified as a primitive short-term tent-camping base; features unsurveyed.
